Transaction in Own Shares AI Summary Close X RS Group plc purchased for cancellation 155,083 ordinary shares in the week 9–13 November 2026 (35,465 on 09/11 at VWAP 793.3704p; 31,466 on 10/11 at VWAP 797.2210p; 29,836 on 11/11 at VWAP 807.5827p; 29,214 on 12/11 at VWAP 812.2736p; 29,102 on 13/11 at VWAP 808.3443p) under its £100.0 million repurchase programme; since commencement the Company has bought 6,418,523 shares for cancellation and, following these cancellations, has 467,630,945 ordinary shares in issue and 467,630,945 total voting rights with no shares held in treasury. Disclaimer* RS Group PLC 16 November 2026 RS Group plc 16 November 2026 Transaction in Own Shares RS Group plc (the "Company") announces that in the week 9 November 2026 to 13 November 2026, it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each (Ordinary Shares) through Barclays Bank plc, as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme announced on 20 May 2026 (the "Programme"). All Ordinary Shares were purchased from Barclays Bank plc as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange. Following the above purchases and cancellation of these Ordinary Shares, the Company will have 467,630,945 Ordinary Shares in issue, with no shares held in treasury.
